title: Singapore Wildlife and Skyline Escape
alt: Flamingos at the Mandai wildlife reserve in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Mandai deserves a full day. Bird Paradise in the morning, a long lunch, then the Night Safari when the park cools down.
expert.tip: Carry a light poncho for Bird Paradise. The walk through aviaries are misted every afternoon and the birds are most active right after.

summary: Five days split between wildlife and the skyline. A full day at Mandai with Bird Paradise and the Night Safari, the city tour with Gardens by the Bay and the SkyPark, then Universal Studios and the Wings of Time show.
included: Included: 4 nights at the Holiday Inn Express Novena with daily breakfast; Bird Paradise; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Gardens by the Bay with Floral Fantasy; Universal Studios one day pass; Wings of Time; 9 private and shared transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: Bird Paradise and the Night Safari
day_titles.3: City tour, Gardens and the SkyPark
day_titles.4: Universal Studios and Wings of Time

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to Novena
Walk through Jewel before you leave the airport if your flight lands early
Check in and keep the evening light
Optional: Changi Experience Studio or the Canopy Park bridges at Jewel
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer out to the Mandai reserve
Bird Paradise with eight walk through aviaries and the Penguin Cove
Afternoon rest, then the Night Safari with its tram circuit
Nocturnal houses on foot afterwards for the pangolins and civets
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the civic district
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 above the bay
Floral Fantasy and the Supertree grove at Gardens by the Bay
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Early evening on Siloso beach before the show
Wings of Time on the beachfront, water, light and fire
5: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Singapore Novena by IHG
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 4★ · Holiday Inn Express Novena, on the MRT line and a short ride from Mandai

program.name: Mandai, Marina Bay and Sentosa
program.description: Four nights in Novena with a full wildlife day at Mandai, the skyline from level 57 and a theme park day on Sentosa.

activities.name: Bird Paradise
activities.description: Eight walk through aviaries at Mandai, from African wetlands to Amazon river birds, with keeper talks through the day.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the park after dark, then walking trails past the smaller nocturnal animals.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the colonial quarter.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The level 57 observation deck looking down on the bay, the Gardens and the towers of the business district.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Floral Fantasy with its hanging gardens and the Supertree grove, best seen as the lights come on.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass for the Sentosa park with coasters, stunt shows and the themed streets in between.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A short outdoor night show on Siloso beach built from water screens, lasers and pyrotechnics.

activities.name: River Wonders
activities.description: The river themed park next door at Mandai, with giant otters, manatees and a boat ride through the Amazon section.
